Enriched UF₆ becomes ceramic fuel pellets. Every step keeps the uranium's enrichment.
# Uranium Dioxide
In the Chemical Reactor: 100 mB of UF₆, 200 mB of Steam and 100 mB of Hydrogen give a Uranium Dioxide powder at the gas's enrichment, and 400 mB of Hydrofluoric Acid back for the fluorine line.

# Pellets
- The Metal Press with a Pellet Die presses the powder into two Green Fuel Pellets.
- The Induction Furnace (or its array) sinters each into a Fuel Pellet. Sintering is the furnace's own recipe, so it shows under Sintering in JEI.
Pellets carry their enrichment; hover one to see it.
